status: proposed public review compatibility assessment; no retrospective approval or waiver
scope: All 53 changed requirement entries in preserved correction release v1.0.1, compared with original Version 1.0. This does not count new defects and is not the compatibility assessment of the new public-review candidate.
policy: Apply CHANGE_CONTROL.md by normative effect. Contradictory original requirements do not establish compatibility; normative resolutions require behavioral review, with breaking-change escalation when previously conforming behavior is removed.
historical_disposition: Preserve v1.0.1 and its corrective and editorial label as published. The recorded process exception did not waive compatibility obligations. This assessment supplies the missing itemized disclosure; it does not retroactively approve a classification or rename released bytes. Future changes follow the clarified review and versioning policy.
limits: The 13 normative repairs are not a claim that every repair breaks every previously conforming implementation.
No legal or patent-pledge effect is inferred from a release label.
This document establishes no independent assessment, outside security review, release authorization or successful completion of a waived step.
